description: Hospital admission for illness occurred on day 31 post-inception, satisfying the 30-day waiting period threshold.

source.quote: Admission Date: 01-Feb-2026. Diagnosis: Acute Bronchitis (Illness). Inception Date: 01-Jan-2026.

calculation_steps: Computed days elapsed between policy inception (2026-01-01) and hospital admission (2026-02-01): 31 days.
Compared 31 days against mandatory 30-day waiting period threshold.
expected_findings.explanation: The admission occurred 31 days post-inception, satisfying the 30-day initial waiting period.

source.quote: Section 2.1 (Initial Waiting Period): A mandatory waiting period of 30 days shall apply from the policy inception date. Any hospitalization or medical expenses incurred for treatment of illness during the first 30 days of coverage are strictly excluded from reimbursement, except where hospitalization is necessitated solely by an accidental injury sustained after the policy inception date.
